monsters.notes: Medium beast.

actions.description: Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 ft. of it and isn't incapacitated.

monsters.name: Dire Wolf
monsters.notes: Large beast.

actions.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
actions.description: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.description: Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 ft. of it and isn't incapacitated.

monsters.name: Giant Spider
monsters.notes: Large beast. Climb 30 ft. Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Spider Climb; Web Walker (ignores movement restrictions from webbing).

actions.name: Web Sense
actions.description: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1d8+3 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 2d8 poison damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If poison damage reduces it to 0 HP, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining HP, and paralyzed while poisoned this way.

actions.name: Web (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: the target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 12 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. (AC 10; 5 HP; vulnerable to fire; immune to bludgeoning, poison, psychic.)

monsters.name: Lion
monsters.notes: Large beast.

actions.name: Pack Tactics
actions.description: Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 ft. of it and isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Pounce
actions.description: If the lion moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or be knocked prone. If prone, the lion can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

monsters.name: Bandit Captain
monsters.notes: Medium humanoid. A cunning leader of brigands or pirates. Studded leather.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The captain makes three melee attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its dagger. Or it makes two ranged attacks with its daggers.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+3 slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4+3 piercing damage.

actions.name: Parry
actions.description: The captain adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, it must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monsters.name: Berserker
monsters.notes: Medium humanoid. A frenzied warrior of a violent tribe or war band.

actions.name: Reckless
actions.description: At the start of its turn, the berserker can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attacks against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d12+3 slashing damage.

monsters.name: Ogre
monsters.notes: Large giant. Darkvision 60 ft. Hide armor.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8+4 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin

monsters.name: Mimic
monsters.notes: Medium monstrosity (shapechanger). Darkvision 60 ft. Condition immunities: prone. Shapechanger (can disguise as an object). Adhesive (a creature hitting it with a melee attack while it's an object is grappled, DC 13). False Appearance.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+3 bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+3 piercing damage plus 1d8 acid damage.

monsters.name: White Dragon Wyrmling
monsters.notes: Medium dragon. Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Fly 60 ft., swim 30 ft., burrow 15 ft.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+2 piercing damage plus 1d4 cold damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Constitution save, taking 5d8 cold damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

monsters.name: Specter
monsters.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
monsters.resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.notes: Medium undead. Darkvision 60 ft. Fly 50 ft. (hover); listed speed is its flying speed. Incorporeal Movement (can move through creatures/objects as difficult terrain). Sunlight Sensitivity. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3d6 necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken until it finishes a long rest. The target dies if this reduces its maximum to 0.

monsters.notes: Medium undead. Darkvision 60 ft. Condition immunities: exhaustion, poisoned. Sunlight Sensitivity.

monsters.name: Knight
monsters.notes: Medium humanoid. Plate armor. A trained warrior, captain, or sworn protector.

actions.name: Brave
actions.description: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+3 slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 1d10 piercing damage.

actions.name: Leadership (Recharge after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: For 1 minute, the knight can utter a special command whenever a nonhostile creature it can see within 30 ft. makes an attack roll or save. That creature adds a d4 to its roll, provided it can hear and understand the knight.

actions.name: Parry
actions.description: The knight adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, it must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monsters.name: Troll
monsters.notes: Large giant. Darkvision 60 ft. Regeneration 10 (regains 10 HP at the start of its turn; if it took acid or fire damage this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn; dies only if it starts its turn with 0 HP and doesn't regenerate). Keen Smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+4 piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+4 slashing damage.

monsters.name: Wraith
monsters.languages: the languages it knew in life

monsters.notes: Medium undead. Darkvision 60 ft. Fly 60 ft. (hover); listed speed is its flying speed. Incorporeal Movement. Sunlight Sensitivity. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4d8+3 necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution save or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken until it finishes a long rest. The target dies if this reduces its maximum to 0.

actions.name: Create Specter
actions.description: The wraith targets a humanoid within 10 ft. that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a specter under the wraith's control (up to seven at a time).
